transport: SockJS /talk; JSON {type,data}; authenticated connection binds all commands to one room
limits: Audio/video recording uses Janus native WAV/MJR and an internal processor; the largest video track is exported with mixed audio.

Audio, camera and screen mute commands request that the target client stop its local media; server-side Janus session revocation and stream moderation are handled by the Janus proxy and are subject to its implementation.
Unrecognized commands return an unsupported-command error and are not relayed.

Mute/chat state, temporary presenters, scheduled alerts, polls, room state, deletion/archive audit and histories are stored in SQLite. Screen watcher counts reflect active socket watch declarations, not independent Janus subscriber verification.
Audio bridge stop/reset is refused during an active recording.
Private-message and canned-poll history follows the original browser localStorage implementation.
Join/leave webhooks use a reconstructed JSON POST payload; the original webhook body has not been captured. Delivery is at-least-once with stable event IDs, retries, SSRF filtering and optional HMAC.

FCM HTTP v1 and Twilio SMS deliver only when explicitly enabled and configured; failures are reported without claiming provider acceptance. Email alerts require opted-in approved members. Social posting uses the X API only when explicitly enabled and credentials are configured; its original provider authentication protocol was not captured.

YouTube/Facebook RTMP egress and OBS ingress require explicit provider opt-in and running media services. Egress is marked live only after output frames; OBS requires audio/video and recommends a 2-second keyframe interval. Simultaneous OBS-to-YouTube requires provider opt-in and a restricted destination; it was tested only against a loopback RTMP sink, not an actual YouTube endpoint.

Linked-room alerts relay only to same-owner rooms. Phone dialing uses a reconstructed, explicitly enabled Twilio Voice adapter; its public WSS origin and credentials must be configured. The captured legacy external repeater port command remains unavailable, while active recording and relay workflows use server-owned Janus forwarding.

evidence.youtube_facebook_egress: Synthetic browser WebRTC via real Janus and FFmpeg to an explicitly allowlisted local RTMP sink; ffprobe verified H.264 video and AAC audio. No YouTube/Facebook endpoint was contacted.
evidence.obs_ingress: Synthetic local RTMP publisher through authenticated MediaMTX and FFmpeg into a real Janus Streaming mountpoint; wrong publish path was rejected; recorded RTP converted and ffprobe verified VP8 video and Opus audio. The isolated Chromium browser suite also received video and audio, and verified stop/revocation.
evidence.sms_fcm: Provider protocol tests use mocks only; no real SMS or push messages were sent.
evidence.webhooks: Ephemeral loopback HTTP sink only; outbound external webhook delivery not exercised.
evidence.obs_dual_output: Synthetic OBS input simultaneously delivered recent VP8/Opus RTP packets to Janus and H.264/AAC to an explicitly verified loopback RTMP sink; stop revoked the publisher. No external provider was contacted.
evidence.social: The X v2 alert adapter was exercised only with mocked HTTP responses, including OAuth 1 signatures, explicit opt-in and duplicate suppression; no external posts were made.
evidence.phone: A synthetic signed Twilio WebSocket and a second RTP participant exchanged non-silent PCMU audio through the actual local Janus AudioBridge (100 non-silent packets in each direction); mocked Twilio call initiation/hangup and invalid signatures were tested. No external telephone call was placed.
